tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the store catalog by name (Arabic, English, or data name), SKU or brand. Prices shown follow the signed-in user's pricing tier.

query.description: Free text to match against product names, SKU or brand. Null lists recent products.

brand.description: Exact brand name filter, or null.

in_stock_only.description: When true, only products with stock above zero.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Fetch one product with full details (descriptions, prices, stock, datasheet) by its id.

tools.name: list_catalog_taxonomy
tools.title: List categories and brands
tools.description: List all store categories, subcategories and brands, useful before filtering a product search.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.title: List my orders
tools.description: List the orders visible to the signed-in user, newest first, with optional status filter.

status.description: Order status filter (e.g. pending, confirmed), or null for all.

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get order with items
tools.description: Fetch one order the signed-in user may see, including its line items.

tools.name: create_quote_request
tools.title: Create quote request
tools.description: Submit a price quote request to the sales team on behalf of the signed-in user.

product_name.description: Product name if no id is known, or null.

message.description: Details of what is needed, or null.

tools.name: list_content
tools.title: List blog posts or projects
tools.description: List published blog posts or completed projects from the website.

tools.name: list_all_products
tools.title: List all products (admin)
tools.description: Admin only. List products including hidden (inactive) ones, newest first. Filter by text, brand, category or active state.

query.description: Free text to match against names, SKU or brand, or null.

brand.description: Exact brand name filter, or null.

is_active.description: true = only visible, false = only hidden, null = both.

tools.name: create_product
tools.title: Create product
tools.description: Admin only. Create a new product. New products are hidden (is_active=false) unless is_active is set, so they can be reviewed first.

name_en.description: English name. Defaults to name_ar on create.

name_data.description: Internal/data name used by stock imports, or null.

brand.description: Brand name (as in list_catalog_taxonomy), or null.

is_active.description: Show on the store. Defaults to false.

tools.name: update_product
tools.title: Update product
tools.description: Admin only. Update a product. Only the fields provided are changed; pass null to clear an optional field.

name_en.description: English name. Defaults to name_ar on create.

name_data.description: Internal/data name used by stock imports, or null.

brand.description: Brand name (as in list_catalog_taxonomy), or null.

is_active.description: Show (true) or hide (false) on the store.

tools.name: set_product_active
tools.title: Show or hide product
tools.description: Admin only. Show (is_active=true) or hide (is_active=false) a product on the store.

is_active.description: true to show on the store, false to hide.

tools.name: update_product_stock
tools.title: Update product stock
tools.description: Admin only. Set a product's stock to an absolute value (stock) or adjust it by a signed amount (delta). Provide exactly one. Stock can never go below 0.

tools.name: delete_product
tools.title: Delete product
tools.description: Admin only. Permanently delete a product. Refused if the product appears in any order; use set_product_active with is_active=false to hide it instead.

tools.name: create_category
tools.title: Create category
tools.description: Admin only. Create a product category.

key.description: Unique key (a-z, 0-9, dashes). Defaults to a slug of name_en.

tools.name: update_category
tools.title: Update category
tools.description: Admin only. Update a product category. Only the fields provided are changed.

tools.name: create_subcategory
tools.title: Create subcategory
tools.description: Admin only. Create a subcategory under an existing category.

tools.name: update_subcategory
tools.title: Update subcategory
tools.description: Admin only. Rename a subcategory or move it to another category. Only the fields provided are changed.

tools.name: create_brand
tools.title: Create brand
tools.description: Admin only. Create a brand.

slug.description: Unique URL slug. Defaults to a slug of name.

is_active.description: Show on the store. Defaults to true.

tools.name: update_brand
tools.title: Update brand
tools.description: Admin only. Update a brand. Only the fields provided are changed. Renaming does not update products.brand on existing products.

logo_url.description: Logo image URL, or null to clear.

is_active.description: Show (true) or hide (false) on the store.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: Admin only. Change an order's status.

tools.name: update_quote_request_status
tools.title: Update quote request status
tools.description: Admin only. Change a quote request's status.

tools.name: create_blog_post
tools.title: Create blog post
tools.description: Admin only. Create a blog post. Saved as a draft unless status is 'published' (publishing notifies subscribed users).

slug.description: Unique URL slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes).

body_ar.description: Arabic body (HTML/Markdown as used on the site), or null.

body_en.description: English body (HTML/Markdown as used on the site), or null.

tools.name: update_blog_post
tools.title: Update blog post
tools.description: Admin only. Update a blog post. Only the fields provided are changed. Setting status to 'published' publishes it (and notifies subscribed users); 'draft' unpublishes it.

slug.description: Unique URL slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes).

body_ar.description: Arabic body (HTML/Markdown as used on the site), or null.

body_en.description: English body (HTML/Markdown as used on the site), or null.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Admin only. Create a portfolio project. Unpublished unless is_published is true.

slug.description: Unique URL slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes).

is_published.description: Show on the website. Defaults to false.

tools.name: update_project
tools.title: Update project
tools.description: Admin only. Update a portfolio project. Only the fields provided are changed.

slug.description: Unique URL slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes).

is_published.description: Show (true) or hide (false) on the website.
